## Summary

The business-day roll for owner registration dates now skips public holidays as well as weekends. The rule lives in one place — `BusinessDays.rollForward` — which both `ResolveOwnerRegistrationDate` (stamping the owner) and `RejectDailyOwnerLimit` (via the published resolved date) already share, so a date and the day it's counted against continue to roll identically.

Change in `BusinessDays.java`:
- Added the fixed holiday set (`2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28`).
- Extended the roll loop to also advance when the date lands on a listed holiday, extracting the weekend check into a small `isWeekend` helper to keep the loop condition readable.

No other class needed changes — the logic stayed in the single unit responsible for defining a business day.
